Name: RIBO
Description:
What is Ribo?

Imagine a modern office building. It has lights, air conditioning, and security cameras. It’s "smart" because you can turn things on and off with a computer. But it’s not intelligent. It doesn't know if a room is empty. It doesn't know that a critical cooling pump is about to break. It just runs blindly, wasting millions of dirhams in electricity and maintenance costs every year.

Ribo is the brain transplant for these buildings.

We are a UAE-based startup that transforms static buildings into sentient, efficient assets. We do this without expensive renovations or rewiring. Instead, we use a three-part ecosystem:

1.  Ribo-Sense (The Nerves): We glue wireless sensors onto old motors and pumps. These sensors "feel" vibrations and temperature, predicting equipment failures weeks before they happen.
2.  Ribo-Vision (The Eyes): We use simple counters to track where people actually are in the building, so we stop cooling empty rooms.
3.  Ketti (The Brain): Ketti is our AI agent. Instead of complex dashboards, facility managers can just talk to Ketti. They say, "Optimize the West Wing for a meeting," and Ketti handles the rest. 
Ribo uses AI and IoT to make buildings talk, think, and save money, helping the UAE reach its Net Zero 2050 goals.
